notes: Single child = the cell template, rendered per row in its own item scope with write-back (the <list> data model), flowing into `columns` flexible columns (default 3, clamped >=1). Lazy ONLY inside a scrolling viewport (LazyVGrid — a Lazy*Grid reports ~zero ideal height before cells materialize, so an embedded grid collapses); `scroll="false"`/measuring = the EAGER chunked grid (a VStack of HStacks with equal flexible columns, zero-height fillers squaring the last partial row). on:reachEnd fires when the LAST cell appears (pagination). NO LIST-CONSTRUCTS: unlike <list>, <grid> carries no group_by / swipeLeading / swipeTrailing / reorder — DECLARED PARITY, not a gap. The iOS twin (Grid.swift) is deliberately construct-free and those are List-only on every renderer, so no renderer implements them for <grid>; adding them to one renderer alone would violate the unified-codebase law (swipe-to-dismiss has no honest grid analogue anyway — cells share a row). Android: BoundGrid header + android-status.md carry the same ratification.
